OUR STORY

Every laddu carries a little feeling of home.

घरगुती brings the warmth of homemade sweets to moments worth sharing — from everyday tea-time treats to family celebrations and thoughtful gifts. Each laddu is made with simple, familiar ingredients and rolled by hand.

Get in Touch
INGREDIENTS

Good Ingredients. Thoughtful Preparation.

Our laddus draw on nuts, seeds, dates, jaggery, millets and pulses, prepared the traditional way. Exact ingredients vary by variety.

AlmondsCashewsPistachiosDatesSeedsRagiJaggeryBesan
Allergen note: Many of our laddus contain nuts, seeds, ghee or gluten. If you or someone you are gifting to has an allergy, please ask us before ordering.
